title: David Crowley wins messy Democratic primary for Wisconsin governor, defeating progressive Francesca Hong – live
description:
Polls had shown Hong as a clear frontrunner during the campaign, but with large chunks of voters still undecided and an ever-changing field of candidates, polling was difficult

  • David Crowley wins Wisconsin Democratic primary for governor

We’ll also be keeping an eye out on his reaction to Tuesday’s key primary results.
